source_provenance: Illustrative sample. Variant list only; raw genome never stored in the run folder.

apoe.interpretation: ε4 heterozygote — higher lifetime Alzheimer's and cardiovascular risk; LDL/ApoB respond more strongly to saturated fat. Among the most lifestyle-modifiable risk genes.
apoe.sa_context: ε4 frequency is somewhat lower in South Asians, but it stacks on an already-higher cardiometabolic baseline.

lpa_genetic.interpretation: Genetically elevated Lp(a), confirmed by the measured serum Lp(a) of 145 nmol/L. Lifelong, lifestyle-fixed CVD amplifier.
lpa_genetic.sa_context: Elevated Lp(a) is common and under-tested in South Asians — a frequent hidden driver of premature coronary disease.

cad_9p21.interpretation: Two risk copies at the most-replicated common CAD locus; acts largely independent of lipids.

t2d_tcf7l2.interpretation: One risk copy of the strongest common type-2-diabetes variant (impaired insulin secretion); converges with the measured early insulin resistance.
t2d_tcf7l2.sa_context: Adds to the elevated South-Asian 'thin-fat' T2D risk that shows up at lower BMI.

fto.interpretation: One copy of the higher-appetite/adiposity allele — fully responsive to protein, fiber and training.

foxo3.interpretation: Carries a longevity-associated allele (informational context, not actionable).

cyp1a2.interpretation: Slow caffeine metabolizer — afternoon caffeine measurably degrades that night's sleep and next-day HRV, and high intake is less cardiovascularly favorable.

slco1b1.interpretation: Intermediate transporter function — modestly higher statin-myopathy risk. A note for the prescribing physician (favors a non-simvastatin choice or lower dose) if a statin is considered for the lipid picture.

cyp2c19.interpretation: Intermediate metabolizer — dormant advisory; relevant only if clopidogrel or a PPI is ever prescribed.
cyp2c19.sa_context: Loss-of-function alleles are relatively common in South/East Asian populations.

mthfr_c677t.interpretation: Heterozygous — about 65% enzyme activity. With the measured homocysteine of 12.5, the active (methylated) B forms are preferred over folic acid.

mthfr_a1298c.interpretation: No additional activity reduction (matters mainly when compound-heterozygous with C677T).

comt.interpretation: Val/Met intermediate dopamine clearance — favors steady down-regulation modalities (breathwork, Zone-2), which also align with the slow-caffeine result.

actn3.interpretation: Mixed power/endurance muscle-fiber profile — does not override the Zone-2 cardiovascular priority the lipids demand.

vdr.interpretation: Modest vitamin-D-receptor efficiency difference; the measured 25(OH)D of 24 governs dosing.

bdnf.interpretation: Met carrier — aerobic exercise and sleep are especially worthwhile for BDNF (reinforces the cardio + sleep priority ApoE already sets).

caveats: Single common variants carry modest effect sizes; a genotype is a probability shift, not a destiny.
Variant interpretations never override an observed biomarker trend.
Polygenic/odds estimates are mostly European-trained; South-Asian context flags are noted per variant.
APOE ε4 is disclosed factually with a genetic-counseling offer, never deterministically.
